papers:

  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

  - title: "DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs"
    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

  - title: "Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards"
    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710
    category: reward_diversity
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。
      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，
      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。
      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。

  - title: "Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2502.18770
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770
    category: reward_diversity
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，
      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，
      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合"先快后慢"的 reward shaping 原则。

  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===

  - title: "DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale"
    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      根因：clipping 不对称性——概率 0.01 的 token 最多增到 0.012，而概率 0.9 的 token 可达 1.08，
      低概率 token 难以增长，抑制探索。DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（εhigh=0.28 > εlow=0.2）
      为低概率 token 留更大增长空间，加 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0 或 1 的 prompt
      （这些 prompt 产生零梯度，降低有效 batch size）。在 AIME 2024 达 50 分超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse。CED reward 从 reward design 层面
      防止 mode collapse——evidence quality 维度确保 reward 组内有足够 variance，
      不会出现 all-same-reward 的零梯度 prompt。DAPO 的 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0/1 prompt
      与我们观察到的 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象本质相同：extraction-only reward 下大量 prompt
      产生零 advantage，CED 从源头（reward 设计）而非后处理（过滤）解决这个问题。

  - title: "Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO"
    authors: Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: COLM 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 std 归一化引入两个 bias：(1) difficulty bias——std(r) 归一化对低 variance 组
      （全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重，trivial question 主导训练信号；
      (2) length bias——per-token loss 的 1/|o_i| 项使长的错误回答被 under-penalize。
      当 std(r)→0 时 advantage 爆炸或未定义，梯度数值不稳定。
      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化，用无偏 Monte Carlo advantage：Ã = R(q,o_i) - mean(R)。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      与我们的实验发现高度一致：extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 正是
      Dr. GRPO 分析的 difficulty bias 极端情况——大量 prompt 的所有 rollout 得到相同 F1，
      std→0 导致 advantage 异常。CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，
      从 reward 设计而非算法修改角度避免了 Dr. GRPO 发现的 bias。

  - title: "GVPO: Group Variance Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19599
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: alternative_framework
    key_finding: >
      将 KL 约束 reward 最大化的解析解直接嵌入梯度权重，
      variance 项自然平衡 exploration 与 exploitation，维持适度 entropy。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      GVPO 的 variance 项机制与 CED 维持 reward variance 的效果功能类似，
      但 GVPO 是算法层面 implicit regularization，CED 是 reward 层面 explicit structure。

  - title: "REINFORCE++: Stabilizing Critic-Free Policy Optimization with Global Advantage Normalization"
    authors: Jian Hu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2501.03262
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      Prompt-level (local) advantage normalization 导致不准确估计和过拟合。
      Global batch normalization 提供更稳定、理论无偏的 gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      解决 local normalization 的 variance 问题；CED 从 reward 端增加 variance 来源。
      两者在不同层面解决同一问题：防止 gradient signal 消失。

  - title: "DiverseGRPO: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Image Generation via Diversity-Aware GRPO"
    authors: Henglin Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2512.21514
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21514
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: parallel_work
    key_finding: >
      图像生成中 GRPO 后期输出同质化。distributional reward modeling（谱聚类+exploratory reward）
      和 structure-aware regularization 实现 13-18% 语义多样性提升。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      跨域验证了 GRPO mode collapse 的普遍性，distributional reward 思路与 CED 精神相近——
      都是通过 reward 层面结构化信号维持输出多样性。

  - title: "Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2601.23135
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23135
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: theoretical_support

papers:

  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

  - title: "DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs"
    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

  - title: "Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards"
    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710
    category: reward_diversity
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。
      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，
      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。

      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。
      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。

    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2502.18770
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770
    category: reward_diversity
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，
      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，
      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合"先快后慢"的 reward shaping 原则。

  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===

  - title: "DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale"
    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      根因：clipping 不对称性——概率 0.01 的 token 最多增到 0.012，而概率 0.9 的 token 可达 1.08，
      低概率 token 难以增长，抑制探索。DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（εhigh=0.28 > εlow=0.2）
      为低概率 token 留更大增长空间，加 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0 或 1 的 prompt

    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse。CED reward 从 reward design 层面
      防止 mode collapse——evidence quality 维度确保 reward 组内有足够 variance，
      不会出现 all-same-reward 的零梯度 prompt。DAPO 的 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0/1 prompt
      与我们观察到的 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象本质相同：extraction-only reward 下大量 prompt
      产生零 advantage，CED 从源头（reward 设计）而非后处理（过滤）解决这个问题。

  - title: "Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO"
    authors: Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: COLM 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 std 归一化引入两个 bias：(1) difficulty bias——std(r) 归一化对低 variance 组
      （全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重，trivial question 主导训练信号；
      (2) length bias——per-token loss 的 1/|o_i| 项使长的错误回答被 under-penalize。
      当 std(r)→0 时 advantage 爆炸或未定义，梯度数值不稳定。
      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化，用无偏 Monte Carlo advantage：Ã = R(q,o_i) - mean(R)。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      与我们的实验发现高度一致：extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 正是
      Dr. GRPO 分析的 difficulty bias 极端情况——大量 prompt 的所有 rollout 得到相同 F1，
      std→0 导致 advantage 异常。CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持

## Overview of RSFT

Rejection Sampling Fine-Tuning implements a mechanism that generates candidate samples and retains only correct ones, which are then used to fit the model under maximum likelihood, restricting the support to only correct-completion regions.

## Applications and Effectiveness

RSFT has become the prevailing baseline for self-improvement in mathematical reasoning and chain-of-thought LLMs, with comprehensive experiments across math, reasoning, and summarization/dialogue benchmarks validating its effectiveness. For instance, on Qwen-2.5-Math-1.5B, RSFT achieved mean@8 accuracy of 25.6% on MATH.

## Key Limitations

RSFT's strict rejection discards the majority of computationally expensive samples, with only a small set of correct outputs being used, reducing data and learning signal efficiency, especially as task complexity increases.

## Recent Variants and Improvements (2024-2025)

Several enhancements have been proposed:

- AdaSTaR introduces adaptive diversity and curriculum learning, with AdaC modulating update frequency based on model accuracy, phasing in difficult data only as the model improves.

- EEF (Exploring Expert Failures) simulates from intermediate states within unsuccessful attempts and selectively integrates beneficial action subsequences.

- Reward Informed Fine-Tuning (RIFT) relaxes the hard rejection predicate and reuses all samples with a mixed objective, improving statistical efficiency.

## Key Recent Work

**Best-of-N (BoN) Sampling Overview:**
Best-of-N (BoN) sampling with a reward model has been shown to be an effective strategy for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences at the time of decoding.

**Reward Hacking Problem:**
A major challenge identified across recent work is that BoN sampling is susceptible to a problem known as reward hacking. By overoptimizing for a misspecified reward, we can subvert intended alignment goals and reduce overall performance -- a phenomenon commonly referred to as reward hacking.

**Recent Mitigation Approaches (2024-2025):**

## Key Failure Modes and Degradation Issues

**Catastrophic Forgetting**

Recent research confirms that LoRA-tuned models can forget significant parts of the pre-training distribution, sometimes even more than fully fine-tuned models. A common misconception is that parameter-efficient methods (like LoRA or QLoRA) avoid forgetting since the original weights remain unchanged. In reality, the combined model (base + adapters) can still exhibit serious forgetting. LoRA fine-tuning effectively overwrites behavior by adding new weight deltas, and the model's outputs may no longer access the old knowledge.

**Performance Degradation During Fine-tuning**

During fine-tuning, the performance of full fine-tune, QLoRA, and IR-QLoRA consistently degrades, while Q-BLoRA and QA-BLoRA maintain stable performance. An imbalance in fine-tuning quantized LLMs with LoRA exists: overly complex adapter inputs and outputs versus low effective trainability of the adapter, leading to underfitting during fine-tuning.

**Format Collapse**

Format collapse occurs when models produce templated outputs regardless of input, with symptoms including repetitive generations and low diversity.

**Quality Trade-offs**

QLoRA achieves 80-90% of full fine-tuning quality. The additional quantization noise affects some tasks more than others; evaluation on target tasks determines acceptability. However, full fine-tuning retains an advantage in complex domains (e.g., mathematics, programming) where precise parameter adjustments are critical, though this gap narrows with proper hyperparameter tuning.

**Configuration Pitfalls**

The biggest issue beginners encounter is misconfigured 4-bit/bitsandbytes settings (QLoRA) leading to silent failures or NaN losses. Starting simple and testing a tiny batch before scaling up is recommended.

The research from 2024-2025 indicates that while both methods have failure modes, newer balanced approaches like Q-BLoRA show promise in maintaining stable performance during fine-tuning.

## AdaSTaR: Adaptive Data Sampling for Training Self-Taught Reasoners

AdaSTaR addresses Self-Taught Reasoners (STaR), also known as Rejection sampling Fine-Tuning (RFT), which is an integral part of the training pipeline of self-improving reasoning Language Models (LMs).

**The Problem:**
The self-improving mechanism often employs random observation (data) sampling, which results in trained observation imbalance; inefficiently over-training on solved examples while under-training on challenging ones.

**The Solution:**
AdaSTaR introduces a novel algorithm that rectifies this by integrating two adaptive sampling principles: (1) Adaptive Sampling for Diversity: promoting balanced training across observations, and (2) Adaptive Sampling for Curriculum: dynamically adjusting data difficulty to match the model's evolving strength.

**Results:**
Across six benchmarks, AdaSTaR achieves best test accuracy in all instances (6/6) and reduces training FLOPs by an average of 58.6% against an extensive list of baselines. These improvements in performance and efficiency generalize to different pre-trained LMs and larger models, paving the way for more efficient and effective self-improving LMs.

The paper was submitted to arXiv on May 22, 2025 (arXiv:2505.16322) and appears to be a NeurIPS 2025 publication.

## Overview

RIFT is proposed to address the data inefficiency of standard methods like Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Rejection Sampling Fine-Tuning (RFT), which either rely on costly expert data or discard valuable negative samples. Unlike RFT's hard thresholding, RIFT repurposes negative trajectories by reweighting the loss with scalar rewards to learn from both positive and negative trajectories.

## Key Technical Approach

RIFT retains every sampled trajectory and assigns it a scalar reward derived from a quality evaluation metric. The RIFT objective modifies the standard negative log-likelihood loss by reweighting each sample's contribution proportionally to its assigned reward, ensuring that positive-reward samples encourage correct behaviors, whereas negative-reward samples provide reduced or negative gradients.

## Addressing Training Stability

## Recent Research on Faithfulness Hallucination Detection

**Key Papers Found:**

1. **"On A Scale From 1 to 5: Quantifying Hallucination in Faithfulness Evaluation"** (arXiv:2410.12222, October 2024)
   - Investigates automated faithfulness evaluation in guided NLG by developing a rubric template and using LLMs to score generation on quantifiable scales, comparing popular LLMs and NLI models in scoring quality and sensitivity.
   - Developed methods for the generation of synthetic unfaithful data, as well as heuristics to quantify the percentage of hallucination.

2. **"Benchmarking LLM Faithfulness in RAG with Evolving Leaderboards"** (arXiv:2505.04847, May 2025)
   - FaithBench examined hallucinations in diverse LLM-generated summaries and assessed the effectiveness of hallucination detection methods through human annotations.

3. **"FaithLens: Detecting and Explaining Faithfulness Hallucination"** (arXiv:2512.20182, December 2025)
   - An 8B-parameter model achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing advanced LLMs with lower cost, and can offer high-quality explanations that are informative and coherent.

NLI-based approaches determine whether a hypothesis is true (entailment), false (contradiction), or undetermined (neutral) given a premise, defining hallucination/faithfulness scores as the entailment probability between source and generated text.

## Overview

A recent paper from June 2025 characterizes reward hacking in inference-time alignment and demonstrates when and how it can be mitigated by hedging on the proxy reward.

## Key Problem

The research addresses a common paradigm to improve large language model performance by optimizing for a reward model, which assigns a numerical score to an LLM's output indicating how likely it is to align with user preferences or safety goals. However, reward models are never perfect and inevitably function as proxies for complex desiderata such as correctness, helpfulness, and safety.

## Main Findings

The research shows that the characteristic pattern of hacking as observed in practice (where the true reward first increases before declining) is an inevitable property of a broad class of inference-time mechanisms, including Best-of-N and Best-of-Poisson.

The paper introduces Best-of-Poisson (BoP) that provides an efficient, near-exact approximation of the optimal reward-KL divergence policy at inference time. Additionally, HedgeTune, an efficient algorithm to find the optimal inference-time parameter, is introduced to counter this effect and achieves superior reward-distortion tradeoffs on math, reasoning, and human-preference setups.

FaithLens is a cost-efficient and effective faithfulness hallucination detection model that can jointly provide binary predictions and corresponding explanations to improve trustworthiness. The paper is arXiv:2512.20182 (published in 2025).

## Key Research Areas

### LLM-Based Document-Level Relation Extraction Approaches

AutoRE demonstrates that off-the-shelf LLMs fine-tuned via QLoRA adapters on modular RHF (Relation-Head-Facts) subtasks can achieve state-of-the-art results. The extraction is decomposed into three modular steps—relation detection, head entity identification, and tail entity/fact prediction—each realized as a distinct fine-tuned LLM module.

Recent approaches guide LLMs to extract triplets from documents using a pipeline approach, starting with the extraction of head entity, followed by identifying the relation, and concluding with the retrieval of tail entity.

### Evidence Faithfulness and Hallucination

A major concern in LLM-based extraction is hallucination. LLMs frequently hallucinate—generating plausible triplets unsupported by the source text. The root cause is the lack of provenance: existing methods produce triplets without explicit links to their textual origins, making faithfulness unverifiable.

The AEVS framework grounds every triplet element to the source text, ensuring complete traceability in LLM-based knowledge graph extraction, providing character-level provenance for every triplet element and enabling principled hallucination detection.

### Performance Challenges

Inter-sentence (cross-sentence) F1 remains consistently 10–15 points below intra-sentence, highlighting the sustained challenge of long-distance reasoning. The number of triples generated by LLaMA2-13B-Chat is markedly less than that annotated in datasets, suggesting that LLMs tend to label relation-expressing entity pairs as NA, leading to poor outcomes.

## Q-BLoRA: Quantized LLMs Fine-Tuning with Balanced Low-Rank Adaptation

The research identifies an imbalance in fine-tuning quantized LLMs with LoRA: overly complex adapter inputs and outputs versus low effective trainability of the adapter, leading to underfitting during fine-tuning.

### Proposed Solution

Q-BLoRA simplifies the adapter's inputs and outputs while increasing the adapter's rank to alleviate underfitting during fine-tuning. More specifically, the approach reduces the dimensions of the input and output to simplify the adapter's complexity, while increasing the rank of the low-rank matrices to enhance the adapter's representational capacity, with compression and restoration accomplished through non-parameterized operations with negligible computational overhead.

### Additional Variant

For low-precision deployment scenarios, the researchers propose Quantization-Aware fine-tuning with Balanced Low-Rank Adaptation (QA-BLoRA), which builds upon the adapter parameter merging of Q-BLoRA.

### Performance

Comprehensive evaluations on the MMLU benchmark, question-answering tasks, and evaluations using GPT-4 / ChatGPT confirm the consistent effectiveness of Q-BLoRA and QA-BLoRA.

### Publication Status

The work appears to be published in Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics 2025, Pre-MIT Press publication. The paper was originally submitted to arXiv in July 2024 (arxiv:2407.17029).

Based on the search results, I found information about AEVS (Anchor-Extraction-Verification-Supplement):

AEVS is a framework that grounds every triplet element to the source text. It operates in three stages: (1) anchor discovery identifies entities, relation phrases, and attribute values with precise positions, forming a constrained extraction vocabulary; (2) grounded extraction generates triplets linked to discovered anchors; and (3) restoration-based verification validates triplets through hierarchical matching, with a coverage-aware supplement ensuring comprehensive extraction.

The framework addresses the problem that LLMs frequently hallucinate—generating plausible triplets unsupported by the source text. The root cause is the lack of provenance: existing methods produce triplets without explicit links to their textual origins, making faithfulness unverifiable.

Experiments on WebNLG, REBEL, and Wiki-NRE demonstrate consistent improvements over both trained models and LLM-based baselines. Ablation studies confirm that anchor-based constraints are the primary mechanism for hallucination reduction.

The framework has dedicated analyses of anchor discovery quality, computational cost (2.83–4.28 LLM calls per sample), and hallucination rates (0.23–20.23% across model–dataset configurations) providing insights into the framework's practical applicability and limitations.

## "Evaluation of Best-of-N Sampling Strategies for Language Model Alignment"

Best-of-N (BoN) sampling with a reward model has been shown to be an effective strategy for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences at the time of decoding. However, BoN sampling is susceptible to a problem known as reward hacking, where an imperfect reward model can lead to compromised performance on the true objective when over-optimized.

The paper was published in February 2025 (arXiv:2502.12668) by Yuki Ichihara and colleagues. Previous work proposes Regularized BoN sampling (RBoN), which shows that regularization outperforms standard BoN sampling and mitigates reward hacking. However, the prior work lacked analysis of why such regularization improves performance, which is the aim of this study.

Key contributions include:
- A theoretically guaranteed approach called Stochastic RBoN sampling (SRBoN)
- A simpler variant called Sentence Length Regularized BoN that shows comparable or even better performance despite simpler implementation
- Empirical evaluation using the AlpacaFarm and Anthropic's hh-rlhf datasets

The paper is published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research and has code available on GitHub at CyberAgentAILab/srbon.

## Overview

DocKS-RAG is an ICML 2025 poster paper that addresses document-level relation extraction, which aims to extract comprehensive correlations between entities and relations from documents.

## Key Problem

Most existing works conduct transfer learning on pre-trained language models (PLMs) for richer contextual representation, but PLMs-based methods suffer from incorporating structural knowledge such as entity-entity interactions, and struggle to infer implicit relations between entities across different sentences.

## Proposed Solution

DocKS-RAG is a framework that enhances structural and semantic understanding by integrating a Document-level Knowledge Graph and a Sentence-level Semantic Retrieval-Augmented Generation mechanism, and additionally designs a hybrid-prompt tuning method on large language models.

Specifically, the framework constructs a Document-level Knowledge Graph from observable documentation data to capture structural information between entities and relations, and implements a Sentence-level Semantic Retrieval-Augmented Generation mechanism to consider similarity in different sentences by retrieving relevant contextual semantic information.

## Results

Experiments on benchmark datasets show significant improvements over existing methods.

The research was published in the Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2025) and is available through multiple sources including OpenReview and the PMLR proceedings.

CLoQ (Calibrated LoRA initialization for Quantized LLMs) is a simplistic initialization strategy designed to overcome challenges in fine-tuning quantized LLMs.

**Key Details:**

The approach addresses challenges from applying LoRA techniques to quantized LLMs due to the reduced representational precision of quantized weights.

CLoQ focuses on minimizing the layer-wise discrepancy between the original LLM and its quantized counterpart with LoRA components during initialization, leveraging a small calibration dataset to quantize a pre-trained LLM and determine the optimal LoRA components for each layer.

## Paper Summary

The paper is titled "Revisiting NLI: Towards Cost-Effective and Human-Aligned Metrics for Evaluating LLMs in Question Answering".

The paper addresses the challenge that evaluating answers from state-of-the-art LLMs is difficult—lexical metrics miss semantic nuances, whereas "LLM-as-Judge" scoring is computationally expensive. **Results:**

## Inference-Aware Fine-Tuning for Best-of-N Sampling in Large Language Models

The paper is authored by Yinlam Chow and 9 other authors, with the arXiv identifier 2412.15287.

### Main Contribution

The work proposes a novel inference-aware fine-tuning paradigm, in which the model is fine-tuned in a manner that directly optimizes the performance of the inference-time strategy, specifically studying the Best-of-N (BoN) inference strategy, in which a verifier selects the best out of a set of LLM-generated responses.

### Key Technical Approach

The authors devise the first imitation learning and reinforcement learning methods for BoN-aware fine-tuning, overcoming the challenging, non-differentiable argmax operator within BoN.

### Key Findings

The BoN-aware models implicitly learn a meta-strategy that interleaves best responses with more diverse responses that might be better suited to a test-time input—a process reminiscent of the exploration-exploitation trade-off in RL.

### Experimental Results

The methods improve the BoN performance of Gemma 2B on Hendrycks MATH from 26.8% to 30.8%, and Pass@K from 60% to 67%.

The paper has also been accepted at ICLR 2025, demonstrating its significance in the field.

      提出 Stochastic Regularized BoN (SRBoN) 有理论保证的方法。
      发现简单的 Sentence Length Regularized BoN 也能获得 comparable 性能。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      CED reranker 的 regularization 策略参考。
      FREIGE 中 CED score 作为 evidence quality proxy，
      可借鉴 SRBoN 的正则化思路防止 CED reranker over-optimize evidence 而牺牲 extraction quality。

  - title: "Regularized Best-of-N Sampling with Minimum Bayes Risk Objective for Language Model Alignment"
    authors: Yuu Jinnai et al.
    year: 2024
    venue: NAACL 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.01054
    category: inference_time_reranking
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      MBR-BoN：用 Minimum Bayes Risk 目标作为 proximity regularizer 缓解 reward hacking。
      MBR 目标量化 response 与 reference policy 的接近程度。
      在 AlpacaFarm 和 hh-rlhf 上优于 vanilla BoN 和 MBR decoding。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      CED reranker 可借鉴 MBR 正则化——在选择最高 CED score 候选时，
      同时考虑候选与 base policy 的接近程度，防止选择过度偏离 extraction pattern 的输出。

  # === Category 14: RSFT Methodology Advances (New from 2025-05-16 scan) ===

  - title: "AdaSTaR: Adaptive Data Sampling for Training Self-Taught Reasoners"
    authors: Hyung Won Chung et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.16322
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      RFT/RSFT 的随机数据采样导致训练不均衡——已解决的样本被过度训练，困难样本训练不足。
      AdaSTaR 引入两个自适应采样原则：(1) diversity sampling 促进均衡，
      (2) curriculum sampling 根据模型能力动态调整数据难度。
      在 6 个 benchmark 全部取得最优，训练 FLOPs 平均减少 58.6%。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      直接适用于 FREIGE 的 RSFT 阶段。当前 RSFT 随机采样 CED-filtered 数据，
      AdaSTaR 的 curriculum 策略可优化采样——先训简单 relation pair，再逐步引入困难的多跳关系。
      其 diversity sampling 也可缓解 RSFT 数据中 relation type 分布不均的问题。

  - title: "RIFT: Repurposing Negative Samples via Reward-Informed Fine-Tuning"
    authors: Unknown
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2601.09253

    category: rsft_methodology
    role: direct_competitor
    key_finding: >
      RSFT 的 hard rejection 丢弃大量计算昂贵的负样本。
      RIFT 保留所有轨迹，用标量 reward 重新加权 loss，
      正 reward 样本鼓励正确行为，负 reward 样本提供反向梯度。
      引入 stabilized loss 解决 naive reward integration 的训练坍塌问题。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      FREIGE 的 RSFT 同样面临 hard rejection 的效率问题——大量生成但 CED 不达标的样本被丢弃。
      RIFT 的 soft reweighting 可替代 binary CED 筛选：
      用 CED score 作为连续 reward 加权 SFT loss，充分利用所有生成样本。

    relevance_to_freige: >
      FaithLens 的方法验证了 CED 的核心假设：小模型可以做高质量 faithfulness 判断。

      除 NLI entailment score 外，加入 explanation quality reward。

    authors: Sapir Harary et al.

    venue: arXiv 2511.01359
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.01359
    category: faithfulness_nli
    role: method_component

    relevance_to_freige: >
      PrefixNLI 可强化 CED 的实时性：不必等生成完成再评估 evidence faithfulness，
      在 autoregressive 生成过程中即时检测 unfaithful evidence。
      可作为 GRPO training 中的 token-level reward signal。

      轻量 NLI scoring + 简单 lexical-match flag 在 long-form QA 上匹配 GPT-4o 准确率 (89.9%)，

    relevance_to_freige: >
      直接支持 CED 的设计选择：用轻量 NLI 模型（而非昂贵 LLM）评估 evidence quality。
      DIVER-QA 的评估方法可迁移到 DocRE evidence evaluation，

      覆盖 summarization、QA、data-to-text 三类任务。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      提供 faithfulness evaluation 的 benchmark 框架。
